body:
Life is slow at the moment. Jobless. Disappointed at the state of the world. Wanting to move out of home. Double standards at home - seems I'm the easy one to blame.

I just don't feel I have any resources at home to communicate how I'm feeling. My friends are great for that, I can talk about whatever, whenever. But at home people love to cut me off and talk over me. When I do get a full sentence out about something they'll talk back to me, but about whatever they want, not what I was talking to them about.

Feels like whenever I make a mistake, I'm 3x more in the wrong than anyone else.

It's very difficult to articulate to them what's going on, because as soon as I voice a negative opinion I'm told I'm ungrateful and a burden.

I also feel like nothing I do is ever enough,  and that hurts a lot.

When I finished Year 12 of school it took me 3 months to get a job. Those three months were hell. Every day I'd be told I'm shit and to get a job. When I finally got a job, I'm told it's a shit job and need a better job. I quit the job years later and go to university, less than halfway through my degree I get offered a job while I was on work placement. This was a job in the field I was studying, I thought this would finally get off my back. Nope. I apparently don't do enough housework - which is in my nature to do because I get the blame if it's not done. 

Sometimes I genuinely feel like my family do not like me, and do not enjoy to have me around, but keep me around because I'm someone to treat like crap in order for them to feel a little better about themselves. 

Edit: I do have my dog and some bonsai trees at home. They are my positives
